name: Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Hertha
beschreibung: The Baumgartner Hertha holiday apartment is located in the municipality of Ebbs in the Tiroler Unterinntal. The surroundings are characterized by the nearby Kaisergebirge with numerous hiking trails and via ferratas. The accommodation offers a fully equipped kitchen, a bedroom, and a separate living area. The quiet location on the outskirts of Ebbs allows a view of the surrounding mountains and meadows. The Zahmer Kaiser ski area can be reached in a few minutes by car. The atmosphere of the holiday apartment is simple and functional, suitable for couples or small families. A supermarket and restaurants in the village can be reached on foot.
